job.title: Lead Software Engineer
job.description: Lead a cloud-focused full-stack engineering team to design, build, and operate scalable, high-availability web platforms and APIs. Mentor engineers, improve architecture and test coverage, ship features in React/AWS container environments, and drive observability and resilience.
responsibilities: Come up to speed with the tech stack.
Ship a new feature in the cloud platform.
Evaluate the architecture of the cloud platform and suggest potential areas for refactoring.
Assist product in defining the quarterly roadmap of work for the cloud platform team.
Continue to innovate and add features to web-based experiences for gamers.
Play with and give feedback on unannounced hardware products.
Work closely with hardware and software product teams to align on the vision for upcoming products.
Help define hardware and web APIs for seamless interaction with apps and cloud services.
Proactively refactor code for clean design with adequate test coverage.
Evaluate new programming languages, frameworks, and tools.
